content.user_title: Build a clear ideal customer profile
content.value_statement: Teams can lose ICP decisions across scattered notes and inconsistent workspace files. This skill creates, updates, retires, and checks organization-owned ICP documents with explicit approval before sharing changes.
actual_capabilities: Creates an ICP document for a selected organization node in a GTM workspace.
Refines an existing ICP while preserving unrelated accepted facts.
Removes one accepted ICP and explains its ownership and consequences.
Checks ICP placement and content for scoped repair needs.
Uses a company-data structure with visible unknown values.
Stages and inspects only named ICP paths before requesting push approval.
limitations: It does not create, import, delete, or repair the GTM workspace itself.
It does not create personas or qualify leads against saved ICPs.
It relies on accepted user facts and safe supplied sources.
It cannot save changes when the connected environment lacks a durable save mechanism.

use_cases.title: Define a first ICP
use_cases.description: Create a structured ICP for a new target market and keep unknown criteria visible.

use_cases.title: Refine sales targeting
use_cases.description: Update one organization-owned ICP after the sales team learns new fit signals or disqualifiers.

use_cases.title: Audit workspace ICPs
use_cases.description: Check a GTM workspace for malformed or colliding ICP artifacts and prepare scoped repairs.

prompt_templates.title: Create an ICP
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ICP for mid-market B2B SaaS companies. Ask for missing criteria before saving it.

prompt_templates.title: Update ICP criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Update our developer tools startups ICP to exclude companies with fewer than 50 employees. Preserve all unrelated facts.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an owner node
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ICP for regulated platforms under our enterprise organization. Show the proposed owner before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Run an ICP health check
prompt_templates.prompt: Doctor the ICP artifacts in this GTM workspace. Describe the scoped repair set and request approval before saving changes.

output_examples.input: Create an ICP for regional logistics providers.
output: Known criteria: logistics industry and regional operations
Open questions: employee range, revenue range, and technology requirements

output_examples.input: Update the fintech ICP to add a compliance disqualifier.
output: Change: excludes organizations without a documented compliance program
Preserved: existing fit signals, buying context, and unresolved criteria

best_practices: Provide target industries, company size, geography, fit signals, and disqualifiers.
Review the owner organization before approving a new ICP.
Keep uncertain criteria as Unknown until reliable evidence is available.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to create buyer personas or score individual accounts.
Do not infer unsupported criteria from adjacent ICP documents.
Do not approve a push without reviewing the plain-language change card.

faq.question: What is an ICP?
faq.answer: An ideal customer profile defines the types of organizations that are a strong fit for your offering.

faq.question: Can this skill create a new workspace?
faq.answer: No. It only manages ICP documents in an existing connected GTM workspace.

faq.question: Can it create buyer personas?
faq.answer: No. Persona creation belongs to the related persona workflow.

faq.question: Does it research companies automatically?
faq.answer: It uses accepted facts and safe supplied sources. It keeps unresolved criteria as Unknown.

faq.question: When are changes shared?
faq.answer: The skill prepares and inspects a local change first. It requests approval immediately before pushing it.

faq.question: Can it repair old ICP files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect scoped ICP artifacts and prepare accepted repairs while preserving existing facts.
